issue.title: RN: give the grown-up check's Settings › Parent Center footer room and centred icons
issue.body:
Part of #2978. Owner on-device finding, 2026-10-20, on the iPad and the Galaxy:

> "android & ios - the icons in the grown ups dialog that say to manage these checks in settings > parent center and the chevron all need a little more room to breath. Add some padding between them and make sure they're vertically aligned."

## Where

* `experiments/native-architecture/src/rsdDrawing/RsdParentGateSheet.tsx`, `GateManageFooter`, with the styles `footer`, `footerLead`, `footerPath`, `footerPlace` and `footerPlaceName` (`gap: dimensions.space1`). The icon size comes from `parentCenter/parentGateMetrics.ts` (`footerIcon`).

## Likely cause

Located by reading the code; unverified. `footerPath` and `footerPlace` are `html.span`, which render as RN `Text` on native. There `display: flex`, `alignItems` and `gap` are ignored, and the icon sits on the text baseline. `RsdSegmentedPicker.tsx` documents the same trap. The "›" span has no spacing of its own.

## Done when

On both devices, the gear icon, "Settings", the "›", the Parent Center icon and "Parent Center" are vertically centred on one line, with even, visibly larger gaps. A side-by-side screenshot is checked against shipping.
issue.display_title: RN: give the grown-up check's Settings › Parent Center footer room and centred icons

comments.body: Fixed by #3086, merged as 1203a9e1afb5681925a547333edbb7090c31ec1f. On the Galaxy (Release), font scale 1.0 shows the gear, Settings, the separator, the Parent Center icon and the name centred on one line, with 4 px between each icon and its name and 8 px either side of the separator. At font scale 2.0 the path breaks cleanly between Settings › and Parent Center, with nothing overlapping.
